model: Qwen3.6-27B (dense, MTP, multimodal vision encoder ignored)
note: model_type=qwen3_5, architectures=Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration. Text decoder only. Dense FFN (no MoE). Has 1 MTP layer. Difference vs Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: DENSE FFN (intermediate_size=17408) instead of MoE, hidden_size=5120, num_layers=64, num_attention_heads=24, num_kv_heads=4, head_dim=256, attn_output_gate=true (same), linear_num_value_heads=48 (vs 32), vocab_size=248320. Layer pattern: [linear_attn x3 -> full_attn x1] x 16 + 1 MTP layer.
hardware: Intel Arc B60 (Xe2 dGPU, 20 Xe-Cores, 2400 MHz, 24 GB GDDR6)

hw_peaks.memory_bw_note: 24 GB GDDR6, ~384-bit bus @ 12 Gbps = 576 GB/s (estimated; measure via mem_bw.c)

config.layer_pattern: linear_attention x 3 then full_attention x 1, repeated x 16 (full_attention_interval=4)

attn_output_gate.note: H=24*256=6144; swish gate applied to attn_output in full-attn layers. output_gate_type=swish

gated_delta_net.config: qk_heads=16, v_heads=48, K=V=128, kernel=PagedGatedDeltaNet opt, cache_interval=0

fc_gate_up_dense.shape: FC(M, 5120, 17408) x2 (gate and up, all 64 layers)
fc_gate_up_dense.note: All 64 layers (16 full-attn + 48 linear-attn) have dense FFN with intermediate_size=17408. gate and up are separate FCs each of shape FC(M, 5120, 17408). 64*2=128 calls/decode.

fc_down_dense.note: All 64 layers have fc_down. Swish(gate)*up is fused into activation before down. 64 calls/decode.

lm_head.note: Single token output projection. INT8 g=128 (different from body INT4).

mtp_layer.note: 1 extra MTP transformer layer (mtp_num_hidden_layers=1). Adds ~1 full-attn call + 1 dense FFN. Small overhead vs 64 main layers; included in total call count as +1 to respective ops.

small_ops_per_layer: rmsnorm_q (3D, full-attn only: M x 24 x 256, 16 layers)
rmsnorm_k (3D, full-attn only: M x 4 x 256, 16 layers)
rope_q (M x 24 x 64 partial RoPE, full-attn only, 16 layers)
rope_k (M x 4 x 64 partial RoPE, full-attn only, 16 layers)

pa_bench_invocations.pa_decode_kvN: pa_bench decode  1 KV_LEN iters warm bufs i8 (NH=24 NKV=4 HD=256)
pa_bench_invocations.pa_prefill_SN: pa_bench prefill S_LEN 0 iters warm bufs i8 (NH=24 NKV=4 HD=256)

gdn_bench_invocations.gdn_prefill_SN: gdn_bench 1 S_LEN 16 48 128 iters warm bufs T
